reference.title: PLANTED FAULT (bar 03 fix round 1): bars/03-halftone-resolve with the engine's settle time one tick early. bar.json declares the bar's own 0.75 s, so still fails it.

beats: 0 to 0.35 s: the plate is empty paper
0.35 s: the first picture arrives as a coarse grid of small dots; 0.5 s: a grid twice as fine; 0.6 s: the full grid, dots growing to full tone by 0.75 s; then it holds
2.0 s and 3.67 s: a new picture shows at the full grid as a pale dot field and darkens within 0.2 s; then it holds
5.34 s: the plate empties and the cycle starts again
